Entries: Field notes including site attributes like the area sampled, temperature, species observations, and locations. The data also include the label given to eDNA filters, site names, and the qPCR reads per replicate for tidewater gobies and the fish detected by seining.
The data are used to create various data suitable for specific analyses, like DataToResampleSeinesR.csv.
US Geological Survey, Western Ecological Research Center, c/o Marine Science Institute, University of California
Southern California Estuaries: Santa Barbara and Ventura Counties
